_note:
Slots for [brg_contact-restaurants]. NEW SECTION, Contact page, built from Expo SPEC-006. Declared beside the fragment so a slot and its {token} ship in one commit. Generated into website/acf/ by `python3 kit/build-acf.py`. Slot names are underscore-only. `text`/`textarea` defaults are esc_html'd on fill, so write literal characters — a literal `&` and a literal `—`, never `&` or `—`.

Closing band. Exists to catch the hole in the routing above: the most likely reason a stranger lands on a restaurant group's Contact page is that they want one restaurant's address or hours, and none of the four cards serve them.

No map embed, deliberately — a third-party map inside a fragment that gets inlined into WordPress means cookies, a consent banner and a second JS engine. The locations already live on /our-restaurants/.

heading.label: Heading
heading.doc: Display face on the teal band, free-wrapping inside 20ch.

sub.label: Sub copy
sub.doc: One line beneath the heading. Write `&` as a literal ampersand.
sub.default: Addresses, hours, and every Board & Brew and Odie's location in one place.

cta_href.doc: Points at the live restaurants page.
